caveats: Q2, Q3 and Q4 values are derived by subtracting prior year-to-date figures from cumulative figures. Only Q1 is a directly reported quarterly value.
The four quarters sum to the full-year figure of $15.817 billion, so the average is simply one quarter of the annual total.

The quarters are not equal in length. Based on the period calendar dates, Q1, Q2 and Q3 each span about 84 days, while Q4 (2026-05-11 to 2026-08-30) spans about 112 days. The simple average therefore does not weight quarters by length.

claims.text: Costco's Q1 fiscal 2026 net cash provided by operating activities was $4.688 billion.
Costco's Q2 fiscal 2026 net cash provided by operating activities was $2.996 billion. This is derived as 7,684,000,000 (year-to-date through 2026-02-15) minus 4,688,000,000 (Q1).
Costco's Q3 fiscal 2026 net cash provided by operating activities was $3.449 billion. This is derived as 11,133,000,000 (year-to-date through 2026-05-10) minus 7,684,000,000.
Costco's Q4 fiscal 2026 net cash provided by operating activities was $4.684 billion. This is derived as 15,817,000,000 (full year) minus 11,133,000,000 (year-to-date through Q3).

Average quarterly net cash provided by operating activities for fiscal 2026 = (4,688,000,000 + 2,996,000,000 + 3,449,000,000 + 4,684,000,000) / 4 = 15,817,000,000 ($15.817 billion) / 4 = about $3.954 billion ($3,954,250,000).

raw_output.summary: Costco's average quarterly net cash provided by operating activities in fiscal 2026 was about $3.954 billion ($3,954,250,000). That is the four quarters summed to $15.817 billion and divided by 4. The quarters were Q1 $4.688 billion, Q2 $2.996 billion, Q3 $3.449 billion and Q4 $4.684 billion.
